faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Click any task card, then drag-drop or click to upload your Excel file. Supports .xlsx, .xls, .csv, .ods formats.
faq.a2: Absolutely! All file processing happens locally in your browser. Data is never uploaded to any server. The network monitor shows real-time if any data is transmitted externally.
faq.a3: After processing, click the 'Export' button and the file downloads directly to your device. No cloud intermediary.
faq.a4: Yes! It can handle files up to 100MB, with a free version limit of 5MB. For large files, it is recommended to use Chrome or Edge browsers.
faq.a5: Export to Excel (with original styles), CSV, JSON, SQL INSERT, SQL IN query and more formats to meet different needs.
faq.q6: What's the difference between Pipeline and Normal mode?
faq.a6: Pipeline mode lets you combine multiple processing steps for complex workflows in one go. Normal mode is for single operations like one-time deduplication or masking. Pipeline is more efficient for complex needs.

s1.title: Overview
s1.desc: PrivSheet is committed to protecting your privacy. We do not collect, store, or transmit any of your data. All data processing is completed locally in your browser, and all temporary data is automatically cleared when you close the page.

s2.title: Data Collection
s2.desc: We do not collect any user data. Specifically:
s2.item1: We never upload your files to any server
s2.item2: We do not collect personal information (name, email, phone, etc.)
s2.item3: We do not use cookies to track your usage
s2.item4: We do not record your operation history or processing results

s3.title: Data Processing
s3.desc: All data processing is completed locally in your browser:
s3.item1: File parsing and data processing are entirely done in browser memory
s3.item2: Processing results are only stored in your local browser session
s3.item3: All temporary data is automatically cleared when you close the browser tab

s4.title: Network Security
s4.desc: We have a built-in network activity monitor (NetworkMonitor) that tracks all network requests in real time. You can check at any time whether any data is being transmitted externally. Under normal usage, there should be no external requests containing your data.

s5.title: Third-party Services
s5.desc: PrivSheet does not rely on any third-party data processing services. All core functions (file parsing, data operations, export) are completed locally and work without internet access.

s6.title: Policy Updates
s6.desc: If this policy changes, we will update the content on this page and modify the last updated date. We recommend that you check this page periodically for the latest privacy protection measures.

s1.title: Origin
s1.desc: PrivSheet started from a simple need — helping people unfamiliar with Excel's complex features quickly complete data processing tasks. From a few simple tools originally built for family, it grew into a full-featured, easy-to-use tool specifically for people who'd rather not learn the intricacies of Excel.

s2.title: Core Principles
s2.desc: PrivSheet's design and development follow these core principles:
s2.item1: Data security first — all processing is done locally, data never leaves your browser
s2.item2: Zero barrier — no registration, no installation, no internet required
s2.item3: What you see is what you get — real-time preview before export
s2.item4: Full functionality — covering data cleaning, masking, conversion, statistics and more
s2.item5: Continuous improvement — constantly optimizing and adding features based on user feedback

s3.title: Technology
s3.desc: PrivSheet is built on Vue 3, uses SheetJS for Excel parsing and ExcelJS for high-fidelity styled export. All calculations and operations run asynchronously in Web Workers for a smooth user experience. The project is licensed under Apache 2.0.

s4.title: Open Source Contribution
s4.desc: PrivSheet is an open source project and welcomes community contributions. You can view the source code, submit issue reports, or participate in feature development on GitHub. We believe in the power of open source and hope that transparency helps users trust our product more.

s1.title: Get in Touch
s1.desc: If you have any questions, suggestions, or feedback, feel free to reach out through the following channels. We'll respond as soon as possible.

s2.github: View source code, submit issues, or contribute

s3.title: Feedback & Suggestions
s3.desc: We value user feedback highly. Whether it's a feature suggestion, bug report, or improvement idea for the user experience, we welcome your input. Every piece of feedback helps us do better.
